top.title: Battery patents: Solid-state filings surpass lithium-ion to hit record high
top.summary: Global solid-state battery patent filings hit a record 2,230 in 2024, up 16%, with South Korea overtaking Japan, driven by Samsung SDI’s rapid growth. items.title: Celebrating men, challenging stereotypes, building a stronger energy future together
items.summary: On International Men's Day, and as Movember raises awareness of men's health and wellbeing, Women in Solar+ Europe (WiSEu) and Solar+ Leaders celebrate the men across the solar and wider energy transition industries who are helping build a more inclusive future. Carmen Madrid, Founder of both initiatives, draws on perspectives shared throughout the network's pv magazine series to reflect on why gender equality is not about women versus men, but about creating workplaces where everyone can thrive, lead authentically and contribute their full potential to the energy transition. The post Celebrating men, challenging stereotypes, building a stronger energy future together appeared first on pv magazine Global .

items.title: The U.S. solar manufacturing landscape in 2026
items.summary: Having watched the global solar industry move from tens of megawatts annual demand to levels in excess of 500 GW by the early 2020s, the United States is finally making moves to create a silicon-based ecosystem to allow its demand for solar to be met by domestically made components. Finlay Colville examines the recent growth in US solar manufacturing. The post The U.S. solar manufacturing landscape in 2026 appeared first on pv magazine Global .
